title: squarespace.get_or_adjust_inventory
description: Input/output contract for the two-operation inventory action on the commerce base URL (https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce). get_inventory = GET /inventory (read). adjust_inventory = POST /inventory/adjustments (write, requires an Idempotency-Key header, reversible by submitting an opposite adjustment). VERIFICATION STATUS: the get_inventory output is fully verified — it mirrors the real 21-record capture in fixtures/inventory.json. The adjust_inventory request body and response are NOT verified: the three-array operation form below is modelled on the documented Squarespace adjustments endpoint and must be confirmed before implementation.

examples.description: Decrementing stock: set an absolute target quantity — there is no negative incrementOperations equivalent.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope. Verified against fixtures/inventory.json.

inventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
inventoryItem.description: All five fields were present on every one of the 21 records in fixtures/inventory.json, so all five are required here.

sku.description: Squarespace-generated SKUs look like SQ1157834, but merchant-set SKUs are free-form, so no pattern is enforced.

descriptor.description: Human-readable label, e.g. "Terra chunk [6]" — product name with the variant attributes in brackets.

cursor.description: With `operation`, cursor must be the only other parameter.

adjustInventoryInput.title: AdjustInventoryInput
adjustInventoryInput.description: UNVERIFIED. At least one operation array must be non-empty. Squarespace rejects the request without an Idempotency-Key header, supplied here as `idempotencyKey` — optional on this input: the connector generates a fresh one when omitted, and reuses the caller's when supplied, so a caller can control retries deliberately.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key request header, not in the body. Optional — the connector generates a fresh UUID when omitted.

incrementOperations.description: Adds stock only — quantity must be >= 1. There is no decrement-via-increment: negative quantities are rejected by Squarespace outright (see the `quantity` field note below). To reduce stock, use setFiniteOperations with an absolute target quantity instead.

quantity.description: CONFIRMED LIVE — negative values disproven, 2026-08-10: Squarespace responds 400 INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR, "quantity must be between 1 and 1000000000, inclusive." for quantity < 1.

adjustInventoryOutput.title: AdjustInventoryOutput
adjustInventoryOutput.description: UNVERIFIED. The live endpoint may answer 204 No Content with an empty body, in which case the connector should synthesise this acknowledgement rather than parse one.
